sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id" AS e, "Products"."product_color" AS g, AVG("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_total_cost") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("Invoice_Line_Items"."derived_product_cost" - "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price") AS REAL) / "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_price")) AS m2 FROM "Invoice_Line_Items" JOIN "Products" ON "Products"."product_id" = "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id"  GROUP BY "Invoice_Line_Items"."product_id", "Products"."product_color"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

why: average of line total cost including VAT per Products within Products.product_color
